description: This file 'Portability.cpp' contains platform-specific implementations and utility functions for cross-platform compatibility, including thread ID retrieval, sleep functions, call stack dumping, and endianness conversions. It also includes licensing information and external dependencies.

methods.name: inet_aton
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 address from the dotted-decimal string format to a network address structure, with platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: usleep
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified number of microseconds on Windows.

methods.name: mremap
methods.description: Stub function for memory remapping on Apple platforms.

methods.name: gettid
methods.description: Retrieves the thread ID on Apple platforms.

methods.name: GetPCFromUContext
methods.description: Extracts the program counter from a ucontext_t structure for backtrace purposes.

methods.name: OverrideStackTopWithPC
methods.description: Modifies a call stack buffer to include the program counter from a thread context.

methods.name: CallstackSignalHandler
methods.description: Signal handler to capture call stack information when triggered.

methods.name: GetCallStack
methods.description: Retrieves the call stack for a given thread ID, either directly or via signal handling.

methods.name: DumpCallStack
methods.description: Dumps the call stack of a specified thread into a list of callstack_info objects.

methods.name: SleepMs
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified number of milliseconds, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: SleepUs
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified number of microseconds, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: htonll
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit integer from host to network byte order, considering endianness.

methods.name: ntohll
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit integer from network to host byte order, considering endianness.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a string with variable arguments into a std::string.

methods.name: ClassName
methods.description: Demangles and returns the class name from a mangled symbol name.

methods.name: ClassNameOnly
methods.description: Extracts only the class name part from a demangled symbol name.

methods.name: Demangled
methods.description: Demangles a symbol name, platform-specific implementation.
